speaker: will_kemp
text: You. Do not leave this room until you have read what somebody thinks I am worth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If this is about the play we have just done, the book is already with Garnish.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It is not Navarre. It is the lovers. A scrap. The Nurse's man. A fan to carry. A part like a dropped glove. Phillips has the bawdy and dies to a roar. Pope has the whole second act. And I carry a fan.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: He has been waving that scrap since the boxes came down. I have read it. I am in no hurry to be the man who laughs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Who wrote it?

speaker: will_kemp
text: Not I. I can write my name and a bill for beer. Garnish, I should think. He is not here to deny it, which is wise of him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not try him in his absence. What do you want, besides a larger glove?

speaker: will_kemp
text: A scene. You have written the house finding the girl dead in her wedding bed. And the musicians come for the wedding and stand in the hall with nothing to play. Give me those musicians. Three minutes beside the bed, and the tears after will sting twice for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three minutes.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three. I can make a dinner of three minutes, and you know it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: And who are the musicians, if I am to stand there and be insulted?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a drum. The board will do on my knee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Peter. That is you. You come from the chamber. The fiddlers are already in the hall. Their names come out of their own catgut. You call for a tune. They do not let you finish it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Names out of catgut. That is a low trick, and it is the right one.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Am I to be paid by the insult? I ask it now, before I am a fiddler and cannot ask it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are paid ten shillings a week, as every hired man is paid. The insult is the part. It is not a second wage.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Ten shillings, and a song I am not let finish. I can live on the ten. I want the song short enough to survive me.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let me see it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It's short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's what the scene will bear.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It's a crust, Master Shakespeare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it's a crust you'll make them laugh at.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will. And the clown war is not over because you have fed me. I will tell you when I am done being grateful, which will be before Sunday.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: If I am the fiddler, I will stand where you put me. I will not add a word. Adding is how a hired man loses the ten shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Add nothing. The tune is called for. It is not finished. That is the whole turn.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. You have a cold instruction and a warm drum. I am taking the scrap, and the new one, before you strike a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take them. I am not writing the vault today. The hall is enough.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I will learn three minutes, and no more.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three minutes. And if you write me a fan again, I will play it as a weapon.
